migration.goal: Complete behavioral superset of fake-gcs-server after the documented environment-key rename and nondestructive data conversion. This is a product target, not an implemented or all-versions compatibility claim.

environment_contract.legacy_keys: Reject with a rename diagnostic; do not use as aliases, fallback values or compatibility-mode selection.
environment_contract.naming_rule: Replace the prefix, retain each setting's suffix and value semantics, and inventory every source setting rather than only the documented examples.
environment_contract.precedence: CLI overrides environment; contradictory renamed/native settings at the same precedence fail deterministically.
environment_contract.storage_boundary: DATA is seed input; DATA_DIR is destination persistence. FILESYSTEM_ROOT requires explicit source conversion, not in-place reinterpretation.
environment_contract.port_boundary: Existing Compose GCS_MIMIC_PORT means host publication, not the process listener; keep container/server mappings separate.

migration.storage_contract: Prefer a transactional metadata catalog plus bounded opaque immutable files; keep foreign seed/filesystem/live-export readers separate from internal persistence. Preserve original data and identities, block lossy import, and validate coherent backup/recovery before cutover. SQLite is the current justified default, not a universal performance winner.
full_superset_gate: Inventory all public source flags/settings, routes, helper/event behavior, backend modes, Go APIs and Storage v1 gRPC; do not silently drop surfaces missing from the current GCS inventory.
Pass the pinned source corpus, representative unchanged clients and migration-preservation cases; legacy emulation and strict Google-contract behavior have separate expectations.
Retain names, bytes, headers/metadata, source identities, ACL/bucket settings and archived versions where exposed; unsupported or inconsistent source state blocks a lossless migration claim.
Verify source immutability, bounded dry-run/import, interruption/retry, resource budgets, endpoint cutover and rollback without losing post-cutover writes.
Report baseline version, profile, supported platforms and remaining gaps; partial releases cannot advertise full replacement. New versions explicitly extend the baseline.

milestones.title: Freeze the complete pinned migration contract
completion_conditions: Inventory all source routes, flags, FAKE_GCS_ settings, Go APIs, legacy v1 gRPC, source backends and helper/event behavior at the pinned revision.
Define GCS_MIMIC_ prefix-only replacements, value/default/error behavior, same-precedence conflicts and no legacy-key fallback; test direct-server and Compose port scopes separately.
Define legacy-compatible versus strict profile expectations for signatures, metadata, errors and seed lifecycle; preserve every known gap and plan missing capabilities as bounded follow-up slices.
Build the reproducible source/destination wire and representative-client corpus without claiming it has already run.
milestones.deferred_scope: No compatibility status promotion, runtime aliases, importer or source test execution is implied by this planning entry.

milestones.title: Import source seed semantics explicitly
completion_conditions: Differentiate source seed trees from durable filesystem roots; preserve empty buckets, names, bytes and source-derived MIME/default metadata under a pinned source profile.
Use bounded traversal/body streams and a read-only source. Verify source-compatible reload/reseed only when explicitly selected; keep native one-time seeding unchanged.
Reject unsupported or inconsistent source attributes with a dry-run report rather than silently dropping them; inventory fields that require later API/ACL implementation.
milestones.deferred_scope: This does not import durable xattr/sidecar state, archived memory generations or make native octet-stream seeding a source-compatible importer.

milestones.title: Convert durable source data without loss
completion_conditions: Read the pinned bucket/object formats and both xattr/sidecar variants from an immutable snapshot into a separate destination; never modify or jointly mount the legacy storage root for writes.

Preflight every resource and preserve source-visible names, generations, ETags, timestamp precision, metadata, bucket settings and ACL/retention fields. Unsupported or corrupt state is a blocking report.

Independently verify size/checksums while streaming, checkpoint import progress with source fingerprints, and test interruption, changed input, conflicts and disk-full without overwriting unrelated data.
Validate old generation-qualified reads/conditions, nonreused future identities, restart readiness and consistent backup/rollback before cutover.
milestones.deferred_scope: A declared live-only subset is not lossless full migration; unsupported histories and policy semantics remain blocking findings.

milestones.title: Preserve Go integration and export ephemeral state
completion_conditions: Provide a separately tested Go-compatible facade for the inventoried constructors, client/handler/lifecycle and direct object methods; a standalone Rust server is not a Go-library drop-in.
Quiesce mutations while the memory source remains alive and export active plus archived generations, metadata and required settings using supported APIs or the Go adapter.
Implement the required version/metadata semantics before accepting such source state. Do not lose archives, truncate identities or stop a memory source before a verified export.
Verify restoration/cutover and explicit draining or preservation of old upload sessions/page tokens; changing endpoint configuration must not be mistaken for token continuity.
milestones.deferred_scope: Transparent hot migration, Go source compatibility and archive preservation remain unclaimed until their own cases pass.

milestones.title: Verify the complete behavioral-superset release claim
completion_conditions: Run all frozen source surfaces on both backends, including TLS/defaults, renamed configuration, JSON/XML, ACL/metadata, batch/rewrite, notifications/helpers, Storage v1 gRPC and representative embedded-Go tests.
Close each baseline gap through an independently scoped delivery slice; no missing source surface is excluded merely to pass the final gate.
Run strict signature/permission cases independently of legacy permissive URL cases, and prove added GCS capabilities do not break source-profile clients.
Publish preserved-data, recovery, platform and resource evidence. Normalize only documented nondeterminism, never missing fields, permissions, imported identities or incorrect bytes.
milestones.deferred_scope: Partial developer releases remain allowed with named migration limits, but cannot claim complete replacement or compatibility with unverified upstream versions.

features.title: Explicit permissive authentication profile
features.notes: auth_mode=permissive is the default and is selected explicitly by CLI --auth-mode, GCS_MIMIC_AUTH_MODE or JSON auth_mode with the existing precedence. It ignores every Authorization header and credential query parameter and performs no permission checks; the ready event reports auth_mode. Permissive results are never counted as strict coverage. Contract: docs/en/slices/strict-auth.md; evidence: docs/en/evidence/strict-auth.md.

acceptance_cases.description: Without auth settings the ready event reports auth_mode permissive without an identity count; anonymous, unknown bearer, Basic, GOOG4 and duplicate Authorization headers all create, read and upload successfully, and credential query parameters are ignored.

auth_mode follows CLI > environment > JSON file > default precedence; unknown or miscased modes, an empty identity_file, strict without identity_file and identity_file with permissive fail before readiness, catalog creation or listener binding.

features.title: Explicit strict authentication profile
features.notes: auth_mode=strict resolves callers from a local bearer-token registry and enforces project-level predefined storage roles on the JSON bucket/object routes, using the iam-json permission per method and storage.objects.delete for an objects.insert overwrite (rechecked in the publication transaction). Unsupported credential schemes and credential query parameters fail with 401 authError and never grant or fall back to anonymous. Local principals simulate Google identity; bucket/object IAM policies, ACLs, allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers, signed URLs and HMAC remain unimplemented. Contract: docs/en/slices/strict-auth.md; evidence: docs/en/evidence/strict-auth.md.

acceptance_cases.description: Unknown, empty, malformed, duplicate and non-UTF-8 bearer values, Basic/GOOG4/AWS4/bare-token schemes and access_token, oauth_token, X-Goog-Signature, X-Goog-Credential, X-Goog-Algorithm, Signature and GoogleAccessId query parameters (including percent-encoded keys) return 401 authError before body reads or catalog access.

Each supported bucket/object route requires its iam-json permission on the bucket's owning project; viewer, creator, editor, cross-project and role-less callers receive 403 forbidden while permitted calls succeed and rejected mutations leave state unchanged.

objects.insert replacing a live object needs storage.objects.delete: the advisory check rejects it with 403 before the body is read or staged, the publication transaction rechecks it so concurrent creates have one winner, and failing preconditions return 412 first.

features.title: Official Java SDK integration
features.notes: Pin a released Google Cloud Storage Java client. Exercise its supported HTTP and gRPC transports separately, endpoint override, streaming/resumable upload, pagination, preconditions and signed URLs. Record client/runtime/transport versions; no blanket SDK compatibility claim.

features.title: Official .NET SDK integration
features.notes: Pin Google.Cloud.Storage.V1 and a .NET runtime. Verify endpoint and credential setup plus streaming CRUD, resumable uploads, metadata, pagination, preconditions and signing against implemented features.

features.title: Official C++ SDK integration
features.notes: Pin google-cloud-cpp storage and the compiler/runtime. Verify the supported transports, endpoint override, streaming transfers, retries, pagination, preconditions and signed access. Keep client memory separate from emulator measurements.

features.title: Official PHP SDK integration
features.notes: Pin google/cloud-storage and PHP. Verify endpoint override, credential fixtures, upload/download, metadata, list pagination, preconditions and signed URLs.

features.title: gcloud storage command integration
features.notes: Use an isolated CLI configuration and endpoint overrides. Test buckets create/describe/list/delete, objects cp/ls/cat/rm, rsync, metadata and IAM commands only as their required endpoints are implemented; record exact commands and version. CLI overrides alone do not prove that signing, control APIs or authentication stay local.

features.title: Legacy gsutil compatibility scope
features.notes: Optional compatibility for existing scripts, with a pinned standalone gsutil and isolated configuration. Current documentation states gsutil will be unbundled from Google Cloud CLI after March 2027. Do not prioritize it over gcloud storage or imply that all gsutil operations are current GCS APIs.

features.title: S3-compatible client subset validation
features.notes: Verify the GCS-supported subset using pinned S3-capable clients and local HMAC credentials. Include supported signature/header and ACL syntax differences. Do not claim full Amazon S3 compatibility merely because GCS exposes an XML API.

features.title: Shared resource state across JSON XML and gRPC
features.notes: Write through each supported transport and read/list/modify through the others. Assert equivalent bytes, logical generations, metadata and authorization while preserving protocol-specific representations and errors. This is an integration gate distinct from independently passing each route.

features.title: Versioned API limits and optional quota model
features.notes: Track published immutable limits separately from adjustable production quotas and local resource budgets. Validate object/name/metadata/context/ACL/list/batch/multipart limits per operation. Make rate/quota simulation deterministic and opt-in; do not emulate cloud capacity or weaken protocol limits silently to meet local disk budgets.

features.title: HTTP body framing and connection semantics
features.notes: Test Content-Length, chunked transfer, empty bodies, truncated bodies, Expect: 100-continue where applicable, connection reuse, and HTTP/2 flow control. Reject malformed or incomplete uploads without publishing partial objects. Bound header/parser state as well as body buffers.

features.title: Disconnected-client resource cleanup
features.notes: Project requirement: slow clients, cancelled tasks and broken upload/download streams release permits, file handles and buffers promptly. Distinguish abandoned ordinary uploads from resumable sessions that must remain recoverable; verify no resource growth across repeated disconnects.

features.title: Disk exhaustion and write failure integrity
features.notes: Project requirement: inject full disk, inode exhaustion, permission failures and database-write failure. A failed upload must not corrupt the prior generation or expose partial state. Bound temporary-disk usage and report the local capacity limit explicitly.

features.title: File descriptor and active-session budgets
features.notes: Project requirement: cap open object files and persistent upload-session state independently of request concurrency. Spill/close idle handles and avoid O(number of stored objects) file descriptors; measure under many small objects and many abandoned sessions.

features.title: Catalog schema upgrade and compatibility policy
features.notes: Project requirement: version the persistent metadata format. Test upgrade with existing generations, permissions and resumable sessions; fail clearly on unsupported newer formats and avoid destructive implicit resets. Document downgrade/backup expectations.

features.title: Bounded telemetry and credential redaction
features.notes: Project requirement: structured request/operation IDs and bounded logging/metric buffers; avoid unbounded object-name or token label cardinality. Redact Authorization, signed query credentials, encryption keys and resumable capability URLs. Observability must not invalidate the memory target.

features.title: Safe blob reclamation during active reads
features.notes: Project requirement: overwrite/delete/lifecycle/restore/rename and background cleanup cannot reclaim bytes needed by an established generation-pinned read. Use a lifetime-aware reclamation strategy and test restart recovery of deferred/orphan bytes; do not hold long catalog transactions to protect readers.

features.title: Local IAM deny-policy evaluation boundary
features.notes: Allow-policy inheritance is already tracked. Add separately configured inherited deny rules only for supported Storage permissions, principals, exceptions and supported conditions; deny precedence must also affect ACL and signed-request decisions where applicable. Creating real IAM v2 deny policies remains outside the GCS emulator.

features.title: Organization policy effects beyond public access
features.notes: Local fixtures for Storage-specific constraints beyond existing PAP/UBLA rows, including authentication-type restrictions and permitted soft-delete retention settings. Document which constraint names and values are evaluated. Real Organization Policy administration is an external service.

features.title: Resource Manager tags and tag-binding boundary
features.notes: Bucket labels/XML tagging and Resource Manager tags are different features. Track direct/effective bucket tag bindings and their IAM/organization-policy uses. The real tagKeys/tagValues/tagBindings APIs belong to Resource Manager; an optional fixture adapter must be labeled simulated.

features.title: Tag-derived soft-delete defaults
features.interface: Bucket creation with external tag fixtures
features.notes: Support an optional inherited storage.defaultSoftDeletePolicy fixture for new buckets, with explicit bucket settings and allowed organization-policy values. Existing buckets must not be silently rewritten when the default changes; model propagation with a test clock if enabled.

features.title: Deprecated notification API scope registry
features.notes: Object change notification is deprecated as of 2026-01-30; it is distinct from Pub/Sub notification configuration/events already tracked. Record a deliberate historical support decision and exact source/version. Do not recreate old watch/channel endpoints by guesswork or infer shutdown merely from deprecation.

features.title: Behavioral release-note and restriction drift review
features.notes: Schema/proto drift is already tracked. Add semantic review of release notes and feature compatibility tables even when the wire schema does not change, for example lifecycle treatment of empty HNS folders, defaults, protocol restrictions, launches and deprecations. Add dated acceptance cases without overwriting prior compatibility claims.

features.title: ViewObjectFullContext v2 HTTP binding
features.notes: Track this observed v2 HTTP binding separately from google.storage.control.v2.StorageControl/ViewObjectFullContext and from storage.objects.viewFullContext in live v1 Discovery. Preserve exact resource-name encoding, context selection, generation and permission behavior; validate real accepted route/parameter forms before claiming aliases.
